rationale: Both floor-target runs (8.49 ns) passed with +0.45 ns, T_eff 8.03, nearly identical despite different PL margin/util, so period_frac stays at 0.45 and the remaining lever is extra signoff slack. Setup is limited at ss 100C max-RC (wire RC matters) and r1-001's worst path touches a port; hold (+0.09, 0 buffers), DRC (converges to 0) and slew/cap (0 vs 953) are not binding, so harder repair is affordable. Keep cap213, post-GRT timing repair, DELAY 4, no routability spreading. Pin both setup slack margins to the 0.4 maximum so repair aims ~0.4 ns past the floor target, and turn on timing-driven placement to shorten critical/port nets at the max-RC corner.
